output.analysis: The sender, Marguerite Dubois of Pelican Fabrication, requests a quote (RFQ) for a comprehensive list of flanges as detailed in an attached, readable PDF (RFQ_PF-26-3091.pdf). The material (ASTM A105) and rating (150# RF) are specified for all flanges, with mill test reports required. Additionally, the body of the email requests two gasket items: 2 sets of 4" 150# spiral wound gaskets (304 SS/graphite) and 6 sets of 6" 150# spiral wound gaskets (304 SS/graphite). No information needs to be excluded as quoted history, hidden, struck, or totals. All info is fully specified and readable.
